headline: Payload ASCEND move is dust: Grumpy Walrus received ~1.6 ASCEND (~2 ADA) in a small 8:43 AM claim-style transfer; its bag is unchanged (~340.0k). Since 8:15 AM it kept repeating the same small buys every 20-40 min: ~3.33k NIGHT for ~704 ADA, ~292k MEPE, ~42.4k COCK and ~613 FLOW for ~213 ADA each, ~26.7k SOLADA for ~72 ADA; net ADA ~-1.43k. FAUCET, MANDO, VICECITY and WASTED are new swarm launches and Pass, logged for SW-01 tracking. COCK side ~147.1k, 1.9% under its line. Nothing passes k/y; no SW-01 ticket.
learned: Lessons: three early-buyer wallets (,, ) now show up across 5-10 launches each, including today's VICECITY, WASTED and WEN, so a coordinated buyer crowd is not a sign of real demand.
